comment: Variation of wizloadlua-tut1-appearance-more: #wizloaddes tut-1 as a Knight with monster detection. wiz_load_splua() calls lspo_reset_level(), which sets in_mklev, so the tutorial's des.monster() calls take makemon()'s level-creation form and print nothing; the Knight reaches tut-1.lua's jump engraving and the role's armor choice, and lspo_finalize_level() post-processes the level. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently.
